title: Private Phoenix and Scottsdale Half-Day City Tour
includes: All taxes, fees and handling charges
Third Party Vendors & Attractions unless specified above (not included)

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the famous architecture, modern art, and desert views that make the cities of Phoenix and Scottsdale such a magical sight. This half-day tour showcases the city's tremendous diversity of culture, scenery, and history, set against the backdrop of the Sonoran Desert. Your pickup begins your excursion to explore the historic Arizona State Capitol building, Old Town Scottsdale, the incredible architecture of the "Jewel of the Desert" at the Arizona Biltmore, and one of the beautiful mountain parks in the Valley.
